name: withdraw-boundary-not-fixed
why: bug 1: exactly the balance is refused.

name: withdraw-allows-overdraft
why: the boundary "fix" removed the check: overdrafts go through.

name: deposit-throws-logic-error
why: bug 2: std::logic_error is the base of std::invalid_argument, not the same type.

edits.old:
if (cents <= 0) throw std::invalid_argument("amount must be positive");
        if (frozen_)
edits.new:
if (cents <= 0) throw std::logic_error("amount must be positive");
        if (frozen_)

name: deposit-zero-allowed
why: zero is not a valid amount.

edits.old:
if (cents <= 0) throw std::invalid_argument("amount must be positive");
        if (frozen_)
edits.new:
if (cents < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("amount must be positive");
        if (frozen_)

edits.old: if (balance_ > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - cents) throw std::overflow_error("balance limit reached");

name: overflow-checked-after-the-addition
why: the check itself overflows: the addition is already undefined behavior.

edits.old:
if (balance_ > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - cents) throw std::overflow_error("balance limit reached");
        balance_ += cents;
edits.new:
balance_ += cents;
        if (balance_ < 0) { balance_ -= cents; throw std::overflow_error("balance limit reached"); }

name: overflow-throws-the-wrong-type
why: the overflow is reported, but as the wrong exception type.

name: last-transaction-returns-a-reference
why: bug 4: a reference into the vector dangles when the vector grows.

name: last-transaction-returns-a-shared-static
why: no dangling, but every account shares the same storage.

name: transfer-without-rollback
why: bug 5: the money has left the sender when the receiver refuses it.

name: transfer-rollback-keeps-the-history
why: the balance is restored, but the sender still has a withdrawal in its history.

name: transfer-swallows-the-error
why: the exception never reaches the caller.

name: ids-are-not-unique
why: bug 6: every account gets the same id.

name: ids-count-by-two
why: unique, but they should count up by one.
